source_evidence: A U.S. broker may be able to process an order for shares of a company that only trades on a foreign securities market.
answer: Trading a foreign stock can mean placing an order for shares that trade only on a foreign securities market. A U.S. broker may be able to process that order. Keep in mind that these companies are not likely to file reports with the SEC, so investors may need to rely on other information sources when making an investment decision.
